upstream.acknowledgment_rule: listener deletes a message only after Scale returns nil; non-nil Scale error stops listener and leaves message for redelivery

github_job.invariant: controller never derives queue depth from lifecycle-message counts

controller_job_admission.invariant: human command tokens, candidate SHA and experiment parameters are absent from infrastructure admission

transitions.event: static config/catalog valid and scale-set session established
request-local deny or root class quarantine

controller_supervisor.invariant: systemd restart is not the request retry mechanism; request-local failures cannot consume StartLimitBurst

transitions.event: root rejects before launch or launch fails

runner_instance.invariant: runner instance is disposable and class-homogeneous; no instance carries job-specific root authority

requirements: atomically persist nonsecret request metadata and JIT SHA-256
stage raw JIT only in root-owned 0600 tmpfs/runtime storage

transitions.event: deterministic systemd transient runner unit successfully created
requirements: unlink root tmpfs raw JIT staging after systemd has inherited the environment

transitions.event: launch/execution terminal failure and cleanup passes
launch fails before systemd unit ownership
requirements: controller removes orphan GitHub JIT registration before creating a fresh runner-instance request

startup_reconciliation: for PREPARING record: inspect deterministic systemd unit identity
if matching unit exists with exact class/request identity, promote to LAUNCHED/ACCEPTED and remove stale JIT staging
if unit does not exist, mark FAILED and remove JIT staging; never fabricate ACCEPTED
for LAUNCHED record: reconcile unit/receipt/cleanup state before serving STATUS
root_capacity_request.invariant: external ACCEPTED means systemd has accepted the runner instance; root never exposes an accepted state that depends on lost in-memory JIT bytes

REQUEST_LOCAL.listener_action: handle durably and return nil; message may be acknowledged

DEFER_RETRYABLE.listener_action: preserve/redeliver work according to explicit retry strategy
DEFER_RETRYABLE.process_action: supervisor reconnect/backoff without consuming systemd crash-loop budget

FATAL_CONFIGURATION_OR_CORRUPTION.listener_action: do not pretend request was handled

recovery_algorithm: load runner-instance ledger and verify catalog/class identity
query root STATUS for every nonterminal request_id
for MISSING entries with recorded JIT registration, remove the exact orphan registration before regeneration
for ACCEPTED entries, retain as live capacity and await root/GitHub terminal evidence
for COMPLETED/FAILED entries, close local runner-instance state without re-execution
live capacity = root-accepted nonterminal runner instances for this class
provision or allow idle capacity to retire according to ephemeral runner lifecycle until live capacity converges
never reconstruct workload/candidate authority from lifecycle strings

maintenance_state_machine.invariant: maintenance never enters scheduler execution protocol

reconciliation_state_machine.ingress: successful exact trusted reconciliation workflow on workspace-control main
reconciliation_state_machine.effect: atomically install/replace root runner-class catalog and class controller policies/identities
reconciliation_state_machine.invariant: policy deployment is separate from candidate scheduling and execution

runner_instance_ledger.identity: one durable local record per root runner-instance request_id
write_order: persist ALLOCATING ledger entry before JIT generation
persist JIT_REGISTERED with runner id and JIT SHA-256 only
submit raw JIT config once over root socket; do not persist raw JIT
persist terminal cleanup reconciliation and archive/compact according to retention policy

jit_secret_handling.unlink_boundary: immediately after deterministic systemd runner unit successfully inherits JIT environment
jit_secret_handling.reboot_semantics: missing tmpfs JIT plus absent deterministic unit resolves PREPARING to FAILED; controller removes orphan GitHub registration and creates a fresh runner-instance request

crash_recovery_matrix.crash_boundary: after controller ALLOCATING ledger, before GitHub JIT generation
crash_recovery_matrix.recovery: root STATUS MISSING; no GitHub registration exists; generate JIT

crash_recovery_matrix.crash_boundary: after GitHub JIT generation, before root request
crash_recovery_matrix.recovery: root STATUS MISSING; remove exact orphan JIT registration from controller ledger, then generate a fresh JIT registration

crash_recovery_matrix.crash_boundary: root PREPARING before systemd unit creation
crash_recovery_matrix.recovery: root startup sees no deterministic unit, marks request FAILED, deletes tmpfs JIT staging; controller removes orphan GitHub registration and creates a fresh runner-instance request

crash_recovery_matrix.crash_boundary: root systemd unit created but process crashes before response
crash_recovery_matrix.recovery: root startup finds exact deterministic unit, promotes PREPARING to LAUNCHED/external ACCEPTED; controller STATUS recovers without re-execution
request is already LAUNCHED; root STATUS is authoritative
root launch/terminal receipt plus GitHub lifecycle enrich runner-instance state; desired future capacity still comes from current TotalAssignedJobs

crash_recovery_matrix.crash_boundary: after runner exits before controller observes JobCompleted
crash_recovery_matrix.recovery: root terminal receipt/cleanup state closes runner-instance request; later GitHub lifecycle is evidence only
root quarantines exact runner class; class controller stays alive but provisions zero new capacity until typed maintenance clearance

catalog_versioning.rule: a runner_class_id denotes one immutable root launch envelope
changes_not_requiring_new_class_id: add/remove trusted workflow route whose launch envelope is identical
change ingress slash-command spelling or workflow-local parameter schema
catalog_binding: root and controller projections carry canonical catalog SHA-256
runner-instance ledger and root execution receipt bind catalog SHA-256
reconciliation may install a new catalog only atomically with its projections
nonterminal requests continue under the catalog identity under which they were accepted or are explicitly drained before cutover
